$comment: Every SSE event the harness can emit, recorded from a checkout by scripts/sync-harness-contract.mjs. check-protocol-parity fails when one of these has no StreamEvent arm — the direction the type system cannot see, because the union ends in an open arm. Do not hand-edit: re-run the sync.
$legacyComment: Renamed to tool_start/tool_end in the harness on 2026-08-22. The harness is self-hosted and versions independently, so a deployment older than that still emits these and the arms must stay. Maintained by hand — the sync cannot infer what a past version sent.
